gizmo.title: Umbuzo wezinombolo
gizmo.description: Umbuzo ophendulwa ngenombolo. Impendulo iyinombolo egxilile noma ifomula esetshenzwa ngokuguquguqukayo, futhi iyabalwa uma ingaphakathi kokubekezelelwa.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Lokho abafundi abakubuzwayo. Bhala igama lokuguquguqukayo kubakaki abagobile, njengo-{d}, ukuze ubonise inani lakho.

configure.title: Iyunithi
configure.description: Kuboniswa njengombhalo eceleni kwendawo yempendulo, isibonelo km/h.

configure.title: Impendulo
configure.description: Inombolo elungile. Shiya kungenalutho uma ifomula ithola impendulo.

configure.title: Ifomula
configure.description: Ithola impendulo kusuka kokuguquguqukayo, isibonelo d / (t / 60). Ingasebenzisa + - * / ^, abakaki, sqrt() kanye ne-abs(). Isetshenziswa esikhundleni sempendulo uma isethiwe.

configure.title: Okuguquguqukayo
configure.description: Izinombolo ifomula nombuzo ezisebenzisayo. Ngayinye ithatha inani phakathi kokuphansi kwayo nokuphezulu kwayo, ngezinyathelo.

advanced.title: Ukubekezelelwa
advanced.description: Ibanga elingakanani kusuka empendulweni eqondile elisabalwa. U-0 usho okuqondile, noma okushaywe ezindaweni zedesimali ezingezansi.

advanced.title: Uhlobo lokubekezelelwa
advanced.description: Ngokuphelele: hlanganisa noma susa ukubekezelelwa. Iphesenti: hlanganisa noma susa lelo phesenti lempendulo eqondile.

advanced.title: Izindawo zedesimali
advanced.description: Abafundi bacelwa ukuthi bashaye kuze kube yilezi zindawo, futhi impendulo iboniswa ishaywe kuzo. Shiya kungenalutho uma kungekho kushaywa.

advanced.title: Imizamo
advanced.description: Izikhathi umfundi angahlola ngazo. U-0 usho ukuthi akunamkhawulo.

advanced.title: Izinombolo ezintsha kuwo wonke umzamo
advanced.description: Khipha amanani amasha okuguquguqukayo njalo uma umfundi ezama futhi. Impendulo yabo yangaphambili ayibe isaboniswa uma bebuya, kuphela ukuthi baphendule kahle yini.

advanced.title: Iyagoqeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomugqa ovuleka futhi uvaleke. Ukuvula owodwa kuvala eminye imibuzo egoqekayo eseduze nawo.

advanced.title: Qala kugoqiwe
advanced.description: Uma igoqeka, qala njengomugqa ovaliwe obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

developer.title: Igama lequizi
developer.description: Igama lequizi elisetshenziselwa ukuhlonza kwe-xAPI ezinhlelweni zokuhlaziya.
